old_html: the DateTimeKind is discarded because sharp-runtime's DateTime does not store it, and a kind value of 3, which the managed constructor rejects, is admitted by the mask.
html: the DateTimeKind is discarded even though sharp-runtime's DateTime has a (ticks, kind) constructor and stores a kind, so a Utc or Local value loads as an unspecified-kind tick count and a Local value is not converted to local time as XNA's reader does (CNA-GAP-034); a kind value of 3, which the managed constructor rejects, is admitted by the mask.
why: The CNA-GAP-034 review found the stated cause stale: sharp-runtime's DateTime stores a kind (packed storage, getKindProperty(), DateTime(longcs ticks, DateTimeKind kind)) and CNA's own XnaIntermediateSerializerTests use the constructor at TARGET; verified by the orchestrator in sharp-runtime next @ 41b918c9.
